subject.title: feat: play ordered track URI lists

question: Should `spogo play` permanently accept variadic track arguments and require a `PlayTracks` operation across all playback engines, with Connect delegating multi-track requests to the Web API?
rationale: This is a new public CLI capability and cross-engine API contract rather than a repair to established behavior, so tests cannot determine whether the added permanent surface and Connect routing are desired product direction.

options.title: Adopt ordered lists
options.body: Accept the tracks-only variadic contract and Web fallback after successful live proof confirms the documented behavior.

options.title: Narrow the API surface
options.body: Retain the user capability but redesign it so engines without native list support do not acquire a required parallel operation.

options.title: Keep single-item play
options.body: Decline the feature and continue using playlists or queue operations for multi-track workflows.

recommendation.title: Adopt ordered lists
recommendation.body: Accept the tracks-only variadic contract and Web fallback after successful live proof confirms the documented behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is the strongest available routing candidate for the repository-wide CLI and playback-engine contract choice.
